prompts.walk:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production anime RPG walking sprite atlas with REAL RGBA transparency.
Input image 1 is ONLY identity/costume reference for adult Ophelia White Equinox, not a background to inherit.
Generate a NEW high-quality 3-column × 4-row atlas of EXACTLY TWELVE separate full-body sprites of the SAME adult witch. Landscape/fantasy anime clean ink outlines and refined cel shading in the established Fate/Mushoku Tensei-inspired game language. Keep her short ice-blue bob, lavender eyes, huge navy pointed hat, small ivory mask PINNED to the hat, snowflake/crescent details, ivory high-neck long sleeves, ornate navy/ivory full-coverage long coat, TWO SEPARATE NAVY WIDE TROUSER LEGS and TWO COMPLETE IVORY/NAVY BOOTS. Keep crescent ice staff. Do not turn trousers into one skirt or obscure a boot. Face stays uncovered.
Grid sequence, row-major:
row1 SOUTH facing toward viewer: neutral walk midpoint, left foot forward/right back, right foot forward/left back.
row2 WEST facing LEFT in profile: neutral, left step, right step.
row3 EAST facing RIGHT in profile: neutral, left step, right step.
row4 NORTH facing AWAY, visible back of hat/hair/costume: neutral, left step, right step.
Every sprite has precisely two arms/two natural hands, two legs/two boots, complete staff, full hat and body. Moderate natural step differences, not twelve repeated standing poses. Coherent adult proportions with a clear readable walking silhouette; equal character scale throughout. Rows and columns are equally sized, three poses aligned to a common ground level per row.
Each entire sprite must fit well inside its own cell with at least 30px of EMPTY ALPHA-ZERO gutter all around; create wide fully transparent horizontal and vertical corridors that run edge-to-edge between every row/column. No part overlaps a neighbor; no cropped hat/staff/boot, no ground/contact shadows, no cast shadow, no fog, no aura, no light haze, no floating particles, NO BACKGROUND gradient or matte. The black/gray/purple halo in the reference must NOT be copied. All pixels outside the actual character/costume/staff are transparent alpha0. No scene/background, no checkerboard painted, no lettering, labels, numbers, panels or dividing lines. Tall 1536×2048 or similarly high native-resolution canvas preferred; do not bake UI/text.
